title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 1 Listening: Joining a social club
subtitle: Useful phrases from Lesson 1 (Listening Section 1)

words.vi: ổn định, dần quen với nơi ở mới
words.def: to start to feel comfortable in a new place
words.sent: Jenny only arrived three weeks ago, so she needs time to sort things out and ___ a bit.

words.vi: được nuôi dạy, lớn lên (ở một nơi)
words.def: to grow up and be cared for by your family in a place
words.sent: Kuala Lumpur is the city where I was born and ___.

words.vi: ở trọ cùng một gia đình (trả tiền thuê)
words.def: to live in a family's home and pay them money
words.sent: I don't have my own flat yet — I'm ___ at 13 Anglesea Road in Bondi.

words.vi: thường xuyên cập nhật thông tin cho ai về việc gì
words.def: to tell someone the news about something again and again
words.sent: Can I have your phone number, so we can ___ events?

words.vi: công việc tạm thời, chỉ làm trong thời gian ngắn
words.def: a job that you do only for a short time
words.sent: I'm only here for six months — I'm doing ___ with an Australian bank.
words.coll: a ___ job, not a permanent one

words.vi: hoà nhập, giao lưu với
words.def: to meet and spend time with other people
words.sent: The main point of the club is to give newcomers the chance to ___ people from this country.

words.vi: có ảnh hưởng tích cực tới
words.def: to change something or someone in a good way
words.sent: Meeting local people usually has a ___ visitors — they feel happier in the new city.

words.vi: mong chờ, háo hức đợi
words.def: to feel happy about something that is going to happen
words.sent: Thanks for your help, Don. I'm really ___ the first meeting.

words.vi: ở nước ngoài, ra nước ngoài
words.def: in or to another country
words.sent: Many Vietnamese students want to study ___ and get a degree in another country.

words.vi: bằng cấp được công nhận quốc tế
words.def: certificates or degrees that are accepted in many countries
words.sent: Employers in many countries accept a degree from that university — it gives you ___.

words.vi: trải nghiệm, trải qua (động từ)
words.def: if you do this, something happens to you and you learn from it
words.sent: Living with a local family is a good way to ___ a different culture.

words.vi: quốc tịch
words.def: the country that you are a citizen of
words.sent: On the form, write your ___ — for example, Malaysian or Vietnamese.

words.vi: nghề nghiệp (ghi trên giấy tờ, biểu mẫu)
words.def: your job, the word used on official forms
words.sent: Name, address, phone number and ___ — Jenny wrote 'economist'.
words.coll: write your name, address and ___ on the form

words.vi: sở thích lúc rảnh rỗi
words.def: the things you like doing when you are not working or studying
words.sent: In the last box of the form, ___, Jenny wrote 'dancing'.
words.coll: free-time ___ such as singing and dancing

words.vi: tiếng lóng
words.def: very informal words that a group of people use
words.sent: Jenny's English is good, but some Australian ___ is hard for her to understand.

words.vi: giọng nói (theo vùng miền, quốc gia)
words.def: the way people from one country or area say words
words.sent: Don says that Jenny has a really nice American ___.

words.vi: thành viên, hội viên
words.def: a person who belongs to a club or group
words.sent: The club has about 50 ___ now, and next year it will have about 80.

words.vi: chuyến đi chơi ngắn (cùng cả nhóm)
words.def: a short trip that a group makes for fun
words.sent: From time to time the club organises ___ to places around Sydney.
words.coll: go on an ___ to the beach

words.vi: bài thuyết trình, bài nói ngắn
words.def: a short talk to a group about a topic
words.sent: Usually one of the members gives a little ___ about where they are from.

words.vi: đánh vần
words.def: to say the letters of a word one by one
words.sent: Could you ___ your surname for me? — Yes, it's F-double O.
